tei:div.tei:p: (ka)༄༅// rje btsun sgrol ma dkar mo la brten pa'i bla slu'i cho ga ring 'tsho'i bcud len zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༄༅// snang brnyan blo ngor shar ba dang*// bzlas pas ring 'tsho'i bcud len mchog /grub mdzad tshe sbyin lha mo la// btud nas bla slu'i cho ga bri// 'di la sbyor dngos rjes gsum las/ dang po ni/ stegs kyi khar sgrol dkar gyi sku brnyan mdun mchod gtor sngon 'gro gtor ma bcas dang*/ 'og tu rin chen phye ma dang gur gum bsres pas bsgrub bya pho mo gang yin dang mthun pa'i bla lug skye mched dod pa'i mtha' skor du bla shing shugs pa dang mkhan dkar/ bla rdo/ dung*/ shel/ bye ru/ mchong smug dung sho/ khyad par bla g.yu drug dkar/ dar tshon/ tshon skud la tshe gzungs sngags rdor mdud btab pa/ de rnams bla phor gyis kha bkab nas snod skyon med du bzhag g.yas su bla rkang lug sha rkang g.yas gzhag shul du nas dkar bsgrub bya'i lo grangs ras dkar thum can bcug ste thel btab pa ras dkar gyis dril ba/ g.yon du bla mtsho mngar gsum rgun 'brum btab pa'i chang gar ma mar khus kha bcad pa'i bum pa/ mdun du bsgrub bya'i gos dri ma can/ de'i mdun du dri zan gyis bsgrub bya'i dbyibs dod pa'i glud gzugs ting lo chang bu 'bru dkar nag sha dum spungs pa gos bcas/ pho la stag pa/ mo la glang ma'i byang bu lo grangs khram btab pho'i phrag g.yas mo'i g.yon du btsugs/ rgyab tu tshon skud dbus nas rim bzhin sngo dkar ser dmar ljang ba'i mthar me ri mtshon byed dmar po can gyi nam mkha'/ de'i g.yas g.yon du lha 'dre'i glud mdog dang gos dkar nag can so so'i mdun sho mig drug dang gcig pa yod pas lha rgyal 'dre pham gyi rnam 'gyur can lha glud la 'bru sna dkar gsum/ 'dre glud la 'bru nag changs bu bstabs pa/ de rnams kyi g.yas su phye mar/ g.yon du chu sna gtsang mar dam rdzas byin can btab pas bkang ba'i ka ṭo rar phor bu'i nang bla lug pho mo gang yin gyi rtags dang ldan pa tshon gyis brgyan pa bcos te bsham/

gzhan yang mda' dar/ bla lug bal can dngos dar snas brgyan pa/ 'bru sna skyems phud/ zhal zas gtor gsos sha dum 'bru dkar nag changs bu sogs dang*/ rang gi mdun du rdor dril/ rol mo'i bye brag sogs sta gon bya'o// gnyis pa ni/ sde brgyad la dkar gtor gser skyems bsngos nas/ sgrol dkar bdag bskyed gtor ma bcas grub mtshams mdun gyi bsgrub rdzas rnams la chab bran nas/ lag gnyis thal mo khong stong du sbyar la/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs gsum/ gtor ma dang mchod rdzas rnams kyi 'bags pa dang mi gtsang ba sogs ma dag pa'i snang ba thams cad stong par gyur/ ces brjod/ de bzhin du/ thal mo sbyar ba'i sor mo gsum gyi tshigs dbus ma bcag la/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bhyo sogs/ gtor ma dang mchod rdzas rnams rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che bar zag pa med pa'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ thal mo sbyar ba'i mdzub mo gung mo'i rgyab nas dkris/ mthe bong bsnol la/ oṃ badzra a mṛ ta sogs/ gtor ma dang mchod rdzas rnams 'dod yon lnga'i rang bzhin du gyur pa thams cad mgron so so'i yid bzhin du thob pa la bgegs dang nyer 'tshe med par gyur/ g.yas pus steng mchog sbyin/ g.yon mnyam bzhag byas la/ oṃ a kā ro sogs/ gtor mgron rnams so sos gang 'dod pa'i dngos po rnams yid bzhin du 'byung bar gyur cig lag g.yon khu tshur bcangs pa pang du bzhag g.yas sdigs mdzub bstan la/ oṃ dzñā na a wa lo ki te na maḥs manta spha ra ṇa rasmi saṃ bha wa sa ma ya ma hā ma ṇi du ru du ru hṛ da ya dzwā la ni swā hā/ gtor mgron rnams drag zhan che chung med par so so'i yid bzhin du tshim zhing rang dbang du longs spyod par gyur cig lag gnyis rdo rje nang bsdams spyi bor bskor te/ na maḥs manta buddhā naṃ gra he shwa ri pra bhañdza ti mahā sa ma ya ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ mchod pa rnams bskal pa ji srid gnas kyi bar du zad pa med cing mgron rnams mnyes pa'i mthu dang ldan par gyur cig

ces sngags rnams lan gsum re brjod pa dang bcas sngags drug phyag drug gis byin gyis brlab/ de nas thog mar khungs smos te bka' nyan par bsgo ba ni/ hūm̐/ na mo sangs rgyas rkang gnyis gtso ste bden pa'i mchog /chos nyid chags dang bral te bden pa'i mchog /dge 'dun 'dus pa'i gtso ste bden pa'i mchog /bden pa'i gtso ni dkon mchog gsum gyi bka'// dkon mchog bka' la mi nyan gang yang med// ri rab zom la mi gnas gang yang med// rgya mtsho'i chu la mi 'thung gang yang med/ 'byung ba lnga la mi brten gang yang med// nyi zla 'od kyis mi khyab gang yang med// mtho srid pa'i rtse mo man chad nas// dma' de na grang dmyal yan chad du// 'phags pa'i spyan gyis gzigs pa'i sa// snang zhing srid pa'i lha 'dre kun// sngags 'chang bdag gi ngag la nyon// dang po bla bslu gang du srid// slob dpon padma'i thugs rje yis// mu khyud 'dzin pa bdud las bslus// bar du bla bslu gang du dar// yi dam lha yi thugs rje yis// srog chags thams cad tshe bsring zhing*// tha ma bla bslu gang du byed// sngags 'chang bdag gi ting 'dzin gyis// yon bdag 'di yi bla 'di bslu// bla 'di bslus nas glud du 'bul// dus dang bskal pa de tsam na// skyob par byed pa'i lha gcig srid// gnod par byed pa'i 'dre gcig srid// lha 'dre gnyis kyi shan 'byed la// lha la lha sho dkar po phul// lha sho dkar po lha yis thob// lha sho de ni che ba byung*// 'dre la 'dre sho nag po gtad// 'dre sho nag po 'dre yis thob// 'dre sho de ni chung ba byung*// de ltar sho de che ba lha yis thob// 'dre sho chung ba 'dre yis thob// lha yang rgyal la 'dre yang pham// de nas bla rten la dgug gzhug bya ba ni/ slob dpon gyis rdor dril mda' dar bcas hūm̐ mdzad kyi phyag rgya dang*/ na mo rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/

yi dam rgyud sde bzhi'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi= dpal mgon dam pa chos skyong ba'i srung ma rnams kyi= bden pa chen po'i byin gyis brlabs kyis sbyin pa'i bdag po che ge mo zhes bya ba'i bla tshe yar ba 'thor ba khyer pa nyams pa brkus pa phrogs pa thams cad rang dbang med par bkug nas/ mdun gyi bla rten 'di la gnyis su med par thim par gyur/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes dang*/ yi dam gyi sngags dang tshe gzungs 'don bzhin pas mda' dar g.yob pa lan gsum gyis 'byung bzhi'i bcud sdud pa'i dmigs pas mdun gyi bla rten rnams la bstim/ de nas bla lug mdun du btags la/ kye/ bla yi lug gu dkar po la// ya mtshan can gyi dar snas brgyan// bla yi rten du khyed la 'bul// bla rkang g.yas pa bla yi rten// bla rkang 'di la bla khug cig /dung sho dkar po bla yi sho /dung sho 'di la bla khug cig /bla g.yu drug dkar bla yi bkrag /bla g.yu 'di la= /mchong long smug po bla yi rten// mchong long 'di la= /bye ru dmar po bla yi khrag /bye ru 'di la= /lha rdo dkar po bla yi rdo// lha rdo 'di la= /lha shing shug pa bla yi shing*// bla shing 'di la= /mkhen bu rtswa bzang bla yi zas// mkhan bu 'di la= /bla mtsho sngon mo bla yi mtsho// bla mtsho 'di la= /nas dkar bre gang lha la 'bul// nas dkar 'di la= /dar tshon sna lnga bla yi bkrag /dar tshon 'di la= /tshon skud sna lnga bla yi lding*// bla lding 'di la= /gshin gyi bla glud ma yin gyi// gson gyi bla glud 'di long la// bla bzung thongs la bcings pa khrol// bsdams pa lhod la mnan pa theg /bla 'di thong la glud 'di long*// bslu yod gcig la bslu yod gnyis// gsum gyi bar du bslu bar bya/ bla ma yol cig bla ma 'gyel cig bla ma nub cig bla ma bkag cig bla ma chibs shig bla ma 'khyams shig 'ba' tshag ge 'dir khug cig bla'i lu gu gsol lo// zhes lan gsum gyis bla 'gugs byas nas/

kye/ khyod 'go ba'i lha la zhal yar ston// skyob pa'i lha la zhal yar ston// srung mda'i lha la zhal yar ltos// le'u'i lha la zhal yar ltos// zhes brjod/ de nas bla bslu ba ni/ kye/ dang po su dang su yi bla// 'phags pa 'jam dpal thugs rje yis// rgyal bu mu khyud 'dzin pa dang*// lag na rdo rje'i mthu stobs kyis// dge slong kun dga' bo yi bla// da ltar su dang su ye bla// da lta rdo rje 'dzin pa yis// sbyin bdag 'di yi bla yang bslu// ya bdud rgyal po 'khor dang bcas// bdud kyi sde tshogs bsam mi khyab// khyed rnams lag na bla yod srid// khyed rnams lag tu bla yod na// gshin gyi bla glud ma yin gyi// gson gyi bla glud 'di long la// bla bzung thong la bcings pa khrol// bsdams pa lhod la mnan pa theg /lan chags bu lon bral bar gyis// khyed rnams lag na bla yod na// man chad 'gres par byas te/ lha rab sham po la sogs te// lha yi sde tshogs bsam mi khyab// lha yi lag na bla yod srid// khyed rnams= /gang ba bzang po la sogs te// gnod sbyin sde tshogs bsam mi khyab// gnod sbyin lag na bla yod srid// khyed rnams= /gtsug na rin chen la sogs te// klu yi sde tshogs bsam mi khyab// klu yi lag na bla yod srid// khyed rnams= /re lde 'gong yag la sogs te// bdud kyi sde tshogs bsam mi khyab// bdud kyi lag na bla yod srid// khyed rnams= /pe har rgyal po la sogs te// rgyal po'i sde tshogs bsam mi khyab// rgyal po'i lag na bla yod srid// khyed rnams= /rmu rje btsan po la sogs te// rmu yi sde tshogs bsam mi khyab// rmu yi lag na bla yod srid// khyed rnams= /skyes bu klu btsan la sogs te// btsan gyi sde tshogs bsam mi khyab// btsan gyi lag na bla yod srid// khyed rnams= /gnyan chen thang lha la sogs te// gnyan gyi sde tshogs bsam mi khyab// gnyan gyi lag na bla yod srid// khyed rnams=

/g.ya' sman gangs sman la sogs te// sman gyi sde tshogs bsam mi khyab// khyed rnams lag na bla yod srid// khyed rnams= /rdo rje legs pa la sogs te// the'u rang sde tshogs bsam mi khyab// khyed rnams lag na bla yod srid// khyed rnams= /bdud dang btsan dang rgyal po dang*// yi dwags smyo byed grul bum sogs// khyed rnams lag na bla yod srid// khyed rnams= /rgyal chen bzhi dang phyogs skyong bcu// gtsang ris dpal mgon bdun cu sogs// khyed rnams lag na bla yod srid// khyed rnams= /yul 'di'i gzhi bdag 'khor dang bcas// khyed rnams lag na bla yod srid// khyed rnams= /gson bdud gshin gcags byed pa rnams// khyed rnams lag na bla yod srid// khyed rnams lag na bla yod na// gshin gyi bla glud ma yin gyi// gson gyi bla glud 'di longs la// bla bzung thong la bcings pa khrol// bsdams pa lhod la mnan pa theg /lan chags bu lon bral bar gyis// de nas bla 'gugs kyi sngags bzla ba ni/ rang nyid yi dam du gsal ba'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer lcags kyu'i rnam pa can dpag tu med pa 'phros/ bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma dang bcas pa'i thugs dam gyi rgyud bskul/ slar yang 'od zer sna tshogs steng 'og kun tu ba thag 'dzings pa ltar 'phros pas sa 'og sa steng sa bla'i khams thams cad khyab/ bla tshe la bar du gcod pa'i steng gdon gza' dang rgyu skar/ 'og gdon sa bdag klu gnyan/ bar gdon btsan dang rgyal po sogs mdor na gdon bgegs kyi rigs su gyur pas bla tshe brkus pa dang*/ phrogs pa dang*/ gzhom pa dang*/ yar ba dang*/ 'khyams pa dang*/ stor ba sogs bkug nas yon gyi bdag por bstims pas nyams pa gsos/ chad pa mthud/ yo ba bsrangs/ sngar bas kyang gzi byin dang ldan pas bla tshe srog gsum mi nor zas gsum la sogs pa rgyas shing brtan par gyur par mos shing spro ba dang bsdu ba'i dmigs pa yang yang bya zhing sngags sgra zur gsal par/

a ha ri ni sa rdzab rdzab rdzub rdzub bha tra slong slong nṛ khug dzaḥdzaḥ zhes pa brgya stong khri 'bum rtags dang sbyar te bzla'o// thun mthar/ mi 'gyur lhun po sogs bkra shis dang*/ gtor mgron gshegs gsol bya'o// de ltar thun gsum byed na rjes ma la yi dam gtor ma/ lha 'dre/ yon bdag gi glud bcas kha gso/ ngag 'don gong bzhin bya/ de lta bus zhag ma gsum lnga bdun sogs rtags byung byung gi bar mtshams dam par byas la bsgrub/ rtags ni/ bla rkang rus bsnum 'jam lci ba/ stod na chu ser dmar po'i bu gu/ snum tshil sman dri bro ba/ 'jug snod kyi nas sngar bas mang la mdog dkar ser du byung ba rnams bzang zhing*/ de dag las ldog pa ngan/ chu bskor bas bla lug bla rten yon bdag la kha gtad cing bsdad na khug rtags bzang*/ phyir log tu gtad na ngan/ bla mtsho'ang ma rul ma nyams ma lud pa bzang*/ phyur zhing lud pa ngan/ rang ngam yon bdag gis g.yu btags pa/ gos ser gyon pa/ rdo rje g.yung drung dung sogs rmis na mchog tu bzang la/ nor rdzas shor ba/ sdug bsngal byung ba/ sbra nag gos nag mi mang khro tshul lta ba sogs rmis na ngan/ de lta bu'i rtags thams cad bzang ba'am bzang ba shas che na sgrub pa grol/ ngan pa shas che na lan gsum sogs bskyar zhing rtags ma rdzogs bar du phan sems snying rjes bsgrubs na mchod yon bde zhing lha 'dre tshim nas 'di phyi'i lan chags byang zhing lha mi 'byung po thams cad byang chub kyi rgyur 'gyur bas nan tan du 'bad par rigs so// gsum pa rjes ni/ gang ltar yang sgrub pa grol nyin bkra shis kyi rjes su/ rgyan gyis brgyan par byas kyang sogs nas/ gdon rnams rang gi gnas su dengs// zhes dang drag sngags brjod la 'dre glud dang yon bdag gi glud gnyis bsgrub bya'i lo bdud phyogs su 'dre pham 'dre pham zhes brjod cing bskyal nas phyi mig mi blta bar log

lha glud mda' dar dang bcas steng khar khyer te yul lhar kha bstan la bzhag phyogs bzhir phyag re dang bcas lha rgyal brjod cing mda' dar g.yugs/ bdag bskyed bsdu ldang bsngo smon bkra shis par byas la/ bla rten rnams las sha chang phye mar rnams zhag bdun bar bsgrub byas longs spyad/ mkhan shug bdug rus pa dang mar lug khyim phug tu sba/ bla lug tshe thar byas nas nyin dang po nas ci bder btang*/ gzhan bla g.yu sogs rten rdzas rnams lus la 'bral med du 'chang bas don 'grub pa yin no// zhes pa'ang sgrol dkar sogs yi dam gang la'ang sbyar chog pa'i bla bslu'i cho ga mdor bsdus snying por dril ba 'di nyid dpal sa skya pa 'jam mgon kun dga' blo gros kyi phyag bzhes rtags thon myang grub can lugs 'dir phyag len mthong brgyud ma nyams pa'i rgyun rdo rje 'dzin pa wā gind+ras bsgrigs pa nyid la brten blo gter dbang pos bkod pa 'gro kun dus min 'chi ba las grol te 'chi med rdo rje'i tshe la dbang 'byor ba'i rgyur gyur cig/ //dge legs 'phel// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
